title: Close staging descriptors on pre-fdopen persistence failures
description: ROBUSTNESS review: FileKeyStore._write_slot, TrustStorePersistence._write_json_locked, TwoSlotFilePersistence._write_slot, and _ensure_tx_marker obtain mkstemp descriptors but only transfer ownership inside a later os.fdopen. If fchmod or another pre-fdopen step raises, the exception path unlinks the name but never closes the descriptor, leaking one fd per failure and enabling exhaustion. Best-effort close the raw descriptor on every failure and test injected pre-fdopen faults.
